fallback_strategy: Implement HADDOCK-style AIR-driven rigid-body sampling and water-stage scoring (E_vdw + 0.2*E_elec + 0.1*E_AIR + 1.0*E_desolv) in pure Python. Validate against SKEMPI 2.0 experimental ddG by per-residue interface energy decomposition.
known_limitations: No CHARMM/OPLSx all-atom forcefield; LJ surrogate with simplified parameters.
No explicit water refinement (it1 + water stage replaced by single AIR-driven rigid-body energy minimization).
Clustering uses ligand-RMSD with single-linkage rather than HADDOCK FCC.
Solvation term approximated by Fauchere-Pliska atom-based desolvation surrogate.
